mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the unemployment rate, indicating a rapidly weakening labor market, will trigger a risk-off sentiment shift and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth decelerates sharply, indicating supply constraints, and the CPI is already elevated (> 4%), it signals stagflation risks that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real yields on 10-year TIPS fall below -1% during the signal period, indicating the market is pricing in aggressive Fed easing that will support risk assets.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth accelerates and the unemployment rate is already low (< 4%), it signals an overheating labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Atlanta Fed Wage Growth Tracker decelerates by > 1pp during the signal period, indicating wage pressures are easing.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth decelerates sharply, indicating a weakening housing market, and the 10-year yield is already elevated (> 4%), it signals a growth slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The NAHB Housing Market Index rises by > 10 points during the signal period, indicating a rapid rebound in homebuilder sentiment.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, indicating aggressive monetary tightening, will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: Real estate investment trust (REIT) prices, as measured by the FTSE NAREIT All Equity REITs Index, lead the broader stock market and can signal a coming downturn when they diverge negatively from the S&P 500.
failure_condition: REITs and SPX exhibit positive correlation (> 0.5) over the 3 months following the negative divergence signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing PMI falls below 45, indicating a manufacturing recession, and the CPI is already elevated (> 4%), it signals stagflation risks that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The ISM Prices Paid Index falls below 50 during the signal period, indicating easing inflation pressures that will support risk assets.
